body.zh-Hant: 鮑里斯三世是保加利亞斐迪南一世的長子，曾就讀索非亞軍事學院，並在兩次巴爾幹戰爭與第一次世界大戰期間於父親的參謀部服務。1918年10月3日，斐迪南一世遜位，由王儲繼位；德國國家圖書館權威檔也記載他於1918年成為保加利亞國王（沙皇）。
body.en: Boris III was the eldest son of Ferdinand I of Bulgaria; he studied at the Military Academy in Sofia and served on his father's staff during the two Balkan Wars and the First World War. On 3 October 1918, Ferdinand I abdicated in favour of the crown prince, and the German National Library authority record also notes that he became King (Tsar) of Bulgaria in 1918.

élève à l'Académie militaire de Sofia
sert dans l'état-major de son père
au cours des deux guerres balkaniques et de la Première Guerre mondiale
dankte F. zugunsten des Kronprinzen ab (3.10.1918)
1918 König (Zar) von Bulgarien

body.zh-Hant: 1930年10月25日，鮑里斯與薩伏依的喬瓦娜結婚，使他與義大利政府圈接觸更頻繁；他與墨索里尼的會面，使他愈發傾向以威權手段解決國內危機。1934年5月19日，他發動政變、解散國民議會（Sobranje），建立個人統治；德國國家圖書館權威檔則概括為自1934年起成為威權君主，並向德意志帝國靠攏。
body.en: His marriage to Giovanna of Savoy on 25 October 1930 brought him into closer contact with Italian government circles, and his meetings with Mussolini inclined him increasingly towards an authoritarian solution to the domestic crisis. On 19 May 1934 he carried out a coup, dissolving the Sobranje (parliament) and establishing personal rule; the German National Library authority record summarises this as authoritarian monarchy from 1934 and a rapprochement with the German Reich.

heading.en: The Second World War and death

body.zh-Hant: 鮑里斯以參加三國同盟換取多布羅加與色雷斯的併入，同時避免與蘇聯斷交。Universalis指出他在1941年3月選定軸心陣營，同年12月讓政府對英國宣戰，卻拒絕對蘇聯作戰；德國國家圖書館權威檔也記有1943年他拒絕讓保加利亞對蘇聯參戰。Treccani載他於1943年8月28日在與希特勒會面後返國時猝死於索非亞。
body.en: Boris secured the annexation of Dobruja and Thrace by adhering to the Tripartite Pact, while avoiding a break with the Soviet Union. Universalis says that in March 1941 he finally chose the Axis, in December 1941 let his government declare war on Britain, but refused to enter the war against the Soviet Union; the German National Library authority record likewise notes his 1943 refusal to take Bulgaria into the war against the USSR. Treccani records that he died suddenly in Sofia on 28 August 1943, on returning from a meeting with Hitler.

people.name: Maximiliano Hernández Martínez
people.nameZh: 馬克西米利亞諾·埃爾南德斯·馬丁內斯

body.zh-Hant: 馬丁內斯生於聖薩爾瓦多，就讀危地馬拉的軍事學院，1899年入伍。1906年與危地馬拉的邊境戰爭期間升遷迅速，受任軍官三年後晉升少校，到1919年已是准將。他多半的軍旅生涯在薩爾瓦多軍事學院任教，並在參謀長辦公室任職。德國國家圖書館權威檔將他列為薩爾瓦多的軍官與國家元首。
body.en: Martínez was born in San Salvador and educated at the Guatemalan military academy; he entered the army in 1899. He rose rapidly during the 1906 border war with Guatemala, reaching major three years after receiving his commission, and by 1919 he held the rank of brigadier general. He spent most of his army career as a professor at the Salvadoran Military Academy and in the office of the chief of staff. The German National Library authority record lists him as a Salvadoran officer and head of state.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年，馬丁內斯以六名總統候選人之一的身分退出，改任阿圖羅·阿拉烏霍的副總統候選人。1931年1月選舉中二人僅得相對多數票，由國民議會選出；他在擔任副總統之外也被任命為戰爭部長。1931年12月2日軍事政變使他掌權，12月5日他依憲法規定就任臨時總統。
body.en: In 1930 Martínez, one of six presidential candidates, withdrew to become the vice-presidential candidate of Arturo Araújo. Receiving only a plurality in the January 1931 election, the pair was elected by the National Assembly, and Martínez was appointed minister of war in addition to his vice presidency. A military coup on 2 December 1931 brought him to power, and he was installed as provisional president on 5 December in accordance with constitutional provisions.

body.zh-Hant: 1932年1月，左派領導的農民起義使馬丁內斯得以鞏固權力；軍隊鎮壓了起義，死亡人數各說不一，從一萬到三萬人不等，史稱「馬坦薩」（屠殺）。美國以1923年華盛頓條約為由拒絕承認其政權，直到1934年1月才予承認。他在1934年違憲安排自己連任，第二任期自1935年3月起算。
body.en: His consolidation of power was helped by a leftist-led peasant uprising in January 1932; the army put the revolt down with casualties variously numbered from 10,000 to 30,000, in what became known as the matanza (massacre). The United States, citing the Washington Treaties of 1923, refused recognition until January 1934. He arranged his own reelection in violation of the constitution in 1934, beginning his second term in March 1935.

body.zh-Hant: 馬丁內斯以嚴酷的獨裁統治國家直到1944年。他肅清了貪腐、停止對外借款並穩定了貨幣，政權以公共工程聞名，包括大量築路與興建政府建築。1944年5月8日，他因再度延長任期的企圖引發的總罷工而被迫下台，此後流亡宏都拉斯直到逝世。
body.en: Martínez held the nation in the tight grip of a harsh dictatorship until 1944. He stamped out corruption, ceased foreign borrowing and stabilized the currency, and his regime was best known for its public works, including extensive road building and many government buildings. He was forced from office on 8 May 1944 by a general strike protesting a new effort to extend his tenure, and he remained in exile in Honduras until his death.

body.zh-Hant: 霍爾蒂1886年被任命為海軍學員；1908至1909年任「陶魯斯」號艦長，1909至1914年出任皇帝弗蘭茨·約瑟夫的侍從武官。一戰期間他接掌「諾瓦拉」號指揮，德國國家圖書館權威檔另記他於1918年成為艦隊司令並晉升少將。
body.en: Horthy was appointed a naval cadet in 1886; he commanded the Taurus in 1908–1909 and served as Emperor Franz Joseph's wing adjutant from 1909 to 1914. During the First World War he took over command of the Novara, and the German National Library authority record adds that in 1918 he became fleet commander and rear admiral.

heading.en: 1919: war minister and the National Army

body.zh-Hant: 1919年霍爾蒂出任卡羅伊·久洛政府的戰爭部長；匈牙利電子圖書館的傳記辭典寫明他於7月接下國防部職務，卡羅伊辭職後成為國民軍總司令，並於11月16日進入布達佩斯。
body.en: In 1919 Horthy became war minister in the counter-revolutionary government of Gyula Károlyi; the Hungarian biographical lexicon (MEK) says he took the war portfolio in July, became commander-in-chief of the National Army after Károlyi's resignation, and entered Budapest on 16 November.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記載霍爾蒂自1920年至1944年任匈牙利王國攝政（Reichsverweser）。匈牙利傳記辭典稱他在1926年促成兩院制國會的成立，1933年與1937年擴大攝政權限；1942年政府設立攝政代理職，由其子霍爾蒂·伊什特萬獲選。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Horthy as regent (Reichsverweser) of the Kingdom of Hungary from 1920 to 1944. The Hungarian biographical lexicon says he established the bicameral parliament in 1926, extended the regent's powers in 1933 and 1937, and in 1942 the post of deputy regent was created, to which his son István Horthy was elected.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年3月19日德國占領匈牙利，霍爾蒂被迫任命新政府；後來他放棄國家元首權力，讓予薩拉希·費倫茨。權威檔記載他1945年成為美軍戰俘並在紐倫堡審判中受訊，1948年移居葡萄牙；匈牙利傳記辭典載他1957年2月9日在葡萄牙埃什托里爾逝世。
body.en: After the Germans occupied Hungary on 19 March 1944 Horthy was forced to appoint a new government; he later renounced his head-of-state powers in favour of Ferenc Szálasi. The authority record notes that in 1945 he was held by US forces and questioned in the Nuremberg trials, that he emigrated to Portugal in 1948, and the Hungarian lexicon gives his death at Estoril, Portugal, on 9 February 1957.
